summary: Verified two TradeChart.jsx behaviours end-to-end on the real /demo-trade page (authenticated against the live VPS backend api.binaryfundglobal.com): (1) lightweight-charts crosshair shows on desktop but is fully hidden on touch devices, and (2) the 50% right-pan clamp holds on both desktop and mobile — the newest candle cannot be pushed further left than the horizontal midpoint of the plotting area.

verifications.auth_setup: Registered TEST user via VPS: test_chart_qa+2026@example.com. Stored JWT in localStorage.bfg_token; page mounted DemoTrade + TradeChart successfully in both viewports.

desktop_1440x900.crosshair_visible_on_hover: YES — thin white dashed vertical + horizontal lines follow the cursor with axis labels (e.g., '1.06982' on price axis and '11:21:00' on time axis) — captured in /app/test_reports/chart_crosshair/v2_desktop_hover.jpeg

clamp_50pct_after_repeated_drag_left.verdict: Clamp holds at ~50% of the plotting area; further drags do not move newest candle further left (repeated 3 drags stayed at 47.1% of wrapper / ~50% of plot area).

mobile_390x844_touch_emulated.crosshair_visible_on_touch: NO — no white dashed axis-following lines rendered. Only the live-price dashed line, live-vert-line at newest candle, and live-price-tag remain — captured in /app/test_reports/chart_crosshair/v2_mobile_hover.jpeg and mobile_touch.jpeg

clamp_50pct_after_repeated_drag_left.verdict: Clamp holds at ~50% of the plotting area; further drags stayed at 42.1% of wrapper (repeats identical).

verifications.regressions_checked: Candles render on both viewports, live-price tag and live-vert-line still track newest candle, chart-clock and mobile tool rail unaffected, no console errors related to the change.

critical_code_review_comments: Clamp measurement in tests uses wrapper width (includes ~35–55px right price axis) so raw ratio reads slightly under 50% (42–47%). Actual chart-plot-area ratio is ~46–50% which matches the intended maxRightOffset = visible/2. If you want the newest candle to land exactly on the visual centre-line of the wrapper, subtract price-axis width from the clamp target — but current behaviour matches the stated spec (‘at least half is candles’).

For quick auth in tests, POST /api/auth/register on api.binaryfundglobal.com then localStorage.setItem('bfg_token', <token>) before navigating to /demo-trade. Touch emulation via CDP: Emulation.setEmulatedMedia hover=none + setTouchEmulationEnabled=true — the TradeChart useEffect reads window.matchMedia('(hover: none)') AT MOUNT time, so emulation MUST be applied before the page loads.
